old: A 1954 five-centavo coin from Argentina, from Juan Perón's first presidency. The side shown has a large 5 with CENTAVOS and the date, and REPUBLICA ARGENTINA around the rim; the other side of this series carries a portrait of José de San Martín, the general who led Argentina to independence.

source: Fix: Perón's first presidency was 1946–1952 and his second 1952–1955 (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Juan_Per%C3%B3n), so a 1954 coin falls in the second; rest checked against Numista N#4835 (https://en.numista.com/catalogue/pieces4835.html)
